title: HUMANS.json — the evidence graph and ranked candidates
description: Candidates are ordered for REVIEW, never accepted by score. A score may order review; it may never convert an unsupported role into a controller. Recorded for audit ONLY. A vendor's matchConfidence, matched:true, or a field literally named property_owner:true is NEVER an input to any predicate or gate (doctrines 2 and 4).

run_id.description: Populated, or an explicit reason token (UNKNOWN, UNEVALUATED, EXPLICITLY-UNAVAILABLE, NOT-APPLICABLE). Never an empty string.

retrieved_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC, second precision, Z-suffixed. Computed at emit time, never hardcoded.

unresolved_frontier.description: REQUIRED. The entity names the chain stopped at. Three hops is an operational limit, not a confidence statement — omitting this implies the chain ended when it did not.

name.description: Populated, or an explicit reason token (UNKNOWN, UNEVALUATED, EXPLICITLY-UNAVAILABLE, NOT-APPLICABLE). Never an empty string.

control_bearing.description: Derived from edge_type. registered-agent, director, generic officer and limited-partner are FALSE and can never by themselves produce a resolved controller.

source.description: Populated, or an explicit reason token (UNKNOWN, UNEVALUATED, EXPLICITLY-UNAVAILABLE, NOT-APPLICABLE). Never an empty string.

dated.description: Populated, or an explicit reason token (UNKNOWN, UNEVALUATED, EXPLICITLY-UNAVAILABLE, NOT-APPLICABLE). Never an empty string.

instrument.description: Which instrument or filing names them, and in what capacity.

anchored.description: Three-valued. UNKNOWN is mandatory (doctrine 18): a check that never ran serializes as UNKNOWN, never N. Coercing missing evidence to N is the single easiest way for this deliverable to lie.

anchor_basis.description: Populated, or an explicit reason token (UNKNOWN, UNEVALUATED, EXPLICITLY-UNAVAILABLE, NOT-APPLICABLE). Never an empty string.

surname_match.description: Three-valued. UNKNOWN is mandatory (doctrine 18): a check that never ran serializes as UNKNOWN, never N. Coercing missing evidence to N is the single easiest way for this deliverable to lie. surname5_prefix_match is a RANKING/LEAD signal only and appears in no acceptance predicate.

geo_match.description: Three-valued. UNKNOWN is mandatory (doctrine 18): a check that never ran serializes as UNKNOWN, never N. Coercing missing evidence to N is the single easiest way for this deliverable to lie.

is_commercial_agent.description: Commercial agents are recorded and excluded from ranking, never contacted.

ambiguity.description: True when the top two are within 20 points, or both anchored, or both carry a control title. Both are emitted as rank 1 and rank 2. Never pick.

vendor_owner_claim.description: Recorded for audit ONLY. A vendor's matchConfidence, matched:true, or a field literally named property_owner:true is NEVER an input to any predicate or gate (doctrines 2 and 4).
